# New Nuka Knights feature: Legendary mods checklists (for all Plus and Prime accounts)

![New Nuka Knights Feature: Legendary Mods Checklists (for all Plus and Prime accounts)](/uploads/458_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

A **new feature** is now available to you in Nuka Knights:

## Legendary Mods Checklists

This function is available on both the website and the app and does not require an update. All you need is an active login and a “**Plus**” or “**Prime**” subscription. You can take out a monthly subscription in your user account and cancel it monthly at any time. It is currently not possible to upgrade from Ad-Free to Plus or Prime. The function for this is still under development. Alternatively, you can cancel your Ad-Free subscription and subscribe to another variant when it expires.

This is how the new feature works:

- Click on your **user profile***You can find your user profile at the top of the navigation under your username on the desktop, in the app or in the mobile browser.*
*![Nuka Knights Profile](/uploads/nukaknights-profile-desktop-mobile-marker-cropped.jpg)*
- Under "**Legendary Mods**" you will now find all legendary 1 star, 2 star, 3 star and 4 star mods as a list.
- You can now check off the legendary mods you have learned in this list. The tag is saved in your profile and is **visible only to you**.
- Using the **arrows** up and the “Index” links will take you back up to the buttons.
- The **buttons** are jump markers for the respective list of mods, so that you can navigate quickly despite the long list.
- You can also check off your mods or jump to your profile in the **posts** in which legendary mods lists appear.

## Roadmap:

There will be more functions similar to this. The next planned feature is “**Event Rewards Checklists**”. The list of each event's rewards will then be available as a checklist that you can save and manage in your profile. 

So you always have an overview of what you have already received in Fallout 76.

Feel free to write your ideas and suggestions in the comments.
